d:
A re-imagining of R-Racing, with main heroine Rena Hayami reworked as a 205 cms tall Japanese girl and how her exceptional height hampers her professional sportcars driver career.

The idea for this re-imagining came to mind because of this Cover for R-Racing, where Rena looks very tall compared to the sportscar behind her: https://mediaproxy.tvtropes.org/width/1200/https://static.tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pub/images/r_racing_evolution.jpg

Rena's canon height is typical Japanese girl on the shorter side, exactly 160 cms tall, but her as a giantess among Japanese women, in a sport typically dominated by male drivers, none of which are as tall as her?

Now that is interesting to work with!

You can read mine and others' comics here too:
